topic: World map travel via Area List
text: To travel on the world map, open the Start menu and choose the 'Area List' option to pick a destination rather than walking the map directly.
In the Area List you first select a region/character heading (e.g. 'Cyril') and then the specific place (e.g. 'Giza Plains') to confirm travel.
Navigate menu entries with the D-pad and press A to confirm each selection; pressing only Down without A never commits the travel choice.
